title: Sieve delivery: fileinto to JMAP mailbox hierarchy
description: Wire Sieve evaluation into the ingestion pipeline for non-list mail (messages without a List-ID header). Per-user Sieve scripts stored in a new DB table: user_sieve_scripts(id, user_id FK, script_name TEXT, script_bytes BLOB, compiled_ast BLOB, active BOOL, created_at, updated_at). Compile script to AST on save; store compiled form for fast evaluation at delivery time. At ingestion: resolve recipient username from RCPT TO, load their active script, evaluate against message envelope and headers. fileinto action: target is a dot-separated mailbox path (e.g. INBOX.Work.ProjectFoo). Create or look up JMAP Mailbox records with parentId nesting — INBOX is the root, each dot component is a child. keep action: deliver to INBOX. discard action: accept the SMTP transaction but drop the message silently. reject action: issue SMTP 550 during the DATA phase (before accepting). Default when no rule matches: deliver to INBOX. Messages that match no recipient user (unknown RCPT TO) are rejected at RCPT TO with 550 5.1.1.
